ctx.x: And you can see the professionals out there in action, like people like Donna Reed, they act like, when we go and play a piece of music, you know, like well, now we're gonna play 'Sunny Side of the Street' -- well, we know
"Sunny Side of the Street" and we'll play it. But those people, when it comes time to act, they go into the character and they act just like we play music.
